theorems.name: Submission.smr_rb_borel_riesz_sigma_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (Y : Type) [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] [LocallyCompactSpace Y] [SigmaCompactSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] (N : ℕ) (L : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap Y (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ K : Set Y, IsCompact K → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap Y (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → tsupport g ⊆ K → L g ≤ B) → ∃ (m : Measure Y) (ν : Y → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), (∀ K : Set Y, IsCompact K → m K < ∞) ∧ Measurable ν ∧ (∀ y, ‖ν y‖ ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ᵐ y ∂m, ‖ν y‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap Y (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)), L g = ∫ y, inner ℝ (g y) (ν y) ∂m
